hero.caption: Bee Hive hut near Slea Head. Taken in 1960. I cannot be certain of its location, but I am certain that it is the same one as photographed by Warren Buckley in 2003 12905, so I am relying on the accuracy of his information, although it is precise only to the km square. Particularly, the pattern of stones to the right of the entrance agree exactly, although there has clearly been some restoration/tidying up of the surroundings.
